courses.name: Plautus
courses.description: Plautine drama. Literary, linguistic and socio-cultural aspects. Readings are in Latin.

courses.name: Ovid
courses.description: Major works of Ovidian poetry. Literary and moral atmosphere of Augustan age. Readings are in Latin.

courses.name: Petronius
courses.description: Reading and analysis of Petronius' Satyricon with an emphasis on the literary climate of the Neronian Age and on the emergence of the novel as a literary genre. Readings are in Latin.

courses.name: Cicero and Sallust
courses.description: Selected speeches of Cicero and selections from the historian Sallust. Rhetorical, social and political context. Readings are in Latin.

courses.name: Special Topics in Latin Language and Literature
courses.description: Readings in Latin at the intermediate level.

courses.name: Latin Historians
courses.description: Latin historical writing as a literary genre. Influences, style, and literary techniques. Readings are in Latin.

courses.name: Vergil's Aeneid
courses.description: Vergil's Aeneid: readings of selections in Latin and of the entire epic in English translation along with critical essays.

courses.name: Historical Development of the Latin Language
courses.description: An analysis of the development of the Latin language from archaic times to the Middle Ages.

courses.name: Latin Readings
courses.description: The reading of one or more selected Latin authors from antiquity through the Renaissance. Reports.
